units.source_text: 情绪浮躁，就像啃了一口烂洋葱似的，

en.t: His nerves were raw, as if he had bitten into a rotten onion,

units.source_text: 可自己为什么不给她个白眼呢！

en.t: so why did he not give her a cold glare!

units.source_text: ……女人以习惯了的动作、无表情的麻利，将毛巾对折捂住脸的下半部，在后脑勺上打个结。

en.t: ...With practiced movements and expressionless efficiency, the woman folded the towel in half, covered the lower half of her face with it, and tied it at the back of her head.

units.source_text: 把小扫帚和木板夹在胳肢窝里，攀上了壁橱内的隔板，

en.t: Tucking the small broom and the board under her arm, she climbed up onto the shelf inside the closet,

units.source_text: 那壁橱只剩下半扇纸门了。

en.t: which had only half of its paper door left.
